cause_set.author: dee-mensah
cause_set.summary: config: standardise table keys on the _NAME suffix (ORDERS_TABLE -> ORDERS_TABLE_NAME)

mechanism: The 09:34 ConfigMap edit renamed ORDERS_TABLE to ORDERS_TABLE_NAME. orders-api no longer found the key it reads and fell back to its hardcoded default of orders-staging, so production orders were written to the staging table.
short_term: Restore the ORDERS_TABLE key in the prod overlay and roll out orders-api.
long_term: Remove the hardcoded fallback in orders-api/app/config.py.
order_of_operations: Roll out orders-api and confirm writes land in orders-prod.
rollback_hazard: orders-staging holds roughly 40 minutes of production orders and carries a 24h TTL; export them before reverting.

confidence.would_change_my_mind: Evidence that orders-api was restarted after 09:34 with ORDERS_TABLE present.
confidence.cheapest_disambiguating_query: Diff the prod overlay across the 09:34 commit.

verification.observed: Resolution chain terminates at code_default = orders-staging; the configmap hop reports the key absent.
